summary.intent: Configure Renovate to limit dependency update checks and branch creation to a schedule of Monday and Thursday mornings, to avoid frequent urgent branches for every dependency update.
summary.outcome: Added a Monday/Thursday morning (Pacific time) schedule to renovate.json on a new chore branch, validated it with pre-commit, committed the change, and logged a Linear issue for the work.

repo: The stopwatch-screensaver repo configures Renovate via a top-level renovate.json.
The repo has a pre-commit setup that includes Renovate config validation, which was used to check the schedule change.
The repo workflow tracks work in Linear (linear-tracking skill) and uses chore branches for config changes like this.

code.finding: Added a schedule restricting Renovate to Monday and Thursday mornings in Pacific time. Exact line numbers were not shown in the transcript.

workflow: Check working tree and current branch before editing, then create a dedicated chore branch for the change.
Validate Renovate config changes with pre-commit before committing.
Create a Linear issue via the linear-tracking skill before making the change, so the work is tracked.

open_items: The change is committed on a chore branch; no push or PR creation appears in the transcript, so it still needs to be pushed and merged.
The schedule timezone and exact morning window were chosen during the session; they may need adjusting if the team wants different times.
